An ally may perform the following *manoeuvre action*:
This character and up to 2 designated allies within **PATH(5)** are *compelled* to **MANOEUVRE** sequentially, each placing a "Link" token after they move. Once all movements are complete, each must be adjacent to at least one other of these allies. They then **SUNDER(-X)** and **WEAKEN(-X)** all adjacent enemies until your next epilogue, where X is the number of allies that moved.
An ally and all adjacent allies gain **ADVANTAGE** on each *attack* by them, until your next prologue.

An ally performs the following *attack action*:
All enemies within **AURA(3)** suffer an **IMPACT(4)**.

An ally performs the following *free manoeuvre action*:
An adjacent character is *compelled* to **MANEUVER(4d{M3/Icons/Dice/NULL.png})**.

When an enemy performs a *manoeuvre* on an adjacent space, this character may perform an **ATTACK** against that enemy.

Transform a "Link" into a "Stele".
